img.text:
Oof. Worst garage sale in
history.

I've been to their family
dinners. Bring a helmet.

"Dear Vikings. Our land is
huge and rich... but
nobody is in charge."

The Vikings? The ones who
raid monasteries for fun?

We could... stop fighting
each other?

Historians aren't sure
that letter ever happened.
But it's a great story.

Great Princess! Our prince
would like to marry you!

How lovely. Come. I'll
give you a great welcome.

Never accept a spa
invitation in the tenth
century.

No alcohol? In this
winter? Next.

Sire... the churches in
Constantinople are
beautiful.
